title: Frontend Development
description: Build responsive, accessible interfaces with HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript.
longDescription: A structured introduction to the foundations behind every great web experience. Learn how semantic structure, thoughtful styling, and JavaScript behavior come together in responsive interfaces.
outcomes: Create responsive layouts with modern CSS

title: React Basics
description: Understand components, props, state, and the patterns behind modern React apps.
longDescription: Learn React through small, focused interfaces that make component thinking feel natural. You’ll build confidence with state, props, events, and reusable UI patterns.

title: API Integration
description: Connect interfaces to real data with resilient requests and clear UI states.
longDescription: Move beyond static interfaces by connecting your React apps to external data. Handle loading, successful responses, failures, and cancellations with user-friendly feedback.

title: JavaScript Forms
description: Create helpful, accessible forms with validation that guides every user.
longDescription: Build forms that are easy to understand and forgiving to use. Learn controlled inputs, field-level feedback, validation rules, and accessible status messaging.

title: UI Design with Tailwind
description: Turn design ideas into polished, consistent interfaces using utility-first CSS.
longDescription: Learn the visual decisions behind clean user interfaces while translating them into flexible Tailwind components. Focus on hierarchy, spacing, color, states, and responsiveness.
outcomes: Apply accessible color and focus states

title: Learning Dashboard Basics
description: Design useful dashboards that make progress, priorities, and actions easy to see.
longDescription: Explore how effective learning products organize information. Build dashboard patterns for progress, course discovery, status, and focused learner actions.
outcomes: Design useful empty and status states
